meta.title: A surrogate bid cannot be placed for a vendor who is not on the event
gaps: The available library case covers a surrogate bid for an invited vendor; the plan removes that vendor first to arrange the uninvited state.

words.preconditions: A fresh RFQ event, published, with one QA vendor invited; bidding open for about 20 minutes.
steps: The buyer removes the invited vendor from the live round for the invited QA vendor.
The buyer sends the bid call, exactly as the matching library case writes it.
words.expected: The app refuses the step the case is about with “Bid could not be placed. Please refresh and try again.”, and never with a server error.
